messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert - report of quality regression for tenant helios-llc (tenant_id: helios-09) on dedicated pool `dp-us-east-2`. Autotriage points to recent quantization/profile change. Incident ref https://redwood.internal/incidents/1835001111
Avery (oncall-sre): ack. Paging runtime and ml-eng. Noah, Priya, can you take a look?
Noah (eng-runtime): Looking. I see a config rollout `rollout-20260401-q8b_fast` at 11:05 to dp-us-east-2 affecting `redwood-ft-3`. Telemetry shows a sharp increase in hallucination indicators (semantic drift) starting ~11:09.
Priya (ml-eng): Confirmed. The quant profile `q8b_fast` reduced precision in certain attention kernels; our internal eval on the customer's prompt set shows correctness drop ~28%.
Avery: Is this tenant pinned anywhere or global? Could we do a per-tenant override quickly?
Noah: Tenant isn't pinned; they inherit pool defaults. We support per-tenant overrides. Fastest mitigation: set per-tenant quant_profile back to `q8b_stable`. Script ready: `tools/tenant_override --tenant helios-09 --pool dp-us-east-2 --set quant_profile=q8b_stable`
support-bot: Support ticket #CS-9987 created by Leo. Customer reported production responses with incorrect legal references. They're on a call with CS.
Priya: I ran a quick local eval: q8b_stable restores metrics to baseline (94% pass vs 66% on q8b_fast) for their prompt corpus. Low risk.
Noah: I'll apply a staged override: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with a 30s observation window. Command: ```
./infra/tenant-override apply --tenant helios-09 --pool dp-us-east-2 --profile q8b_stable --stages 10,50,100 --note "incident 1835001111"
```
ops-bot: Change queued: tenant-override/1835001111 by eng-runtime. Preflight OK. ETA ~2m. job-id job-4427.
Noah: Stage 1 (10%) applied. Routing shows 10% of traffic using q8b_stable.
ops-bot: Routing update: helios-09 -> q8b_stable (10%). job-4427 running.
Avery: Monitor live sample against customer prompt set and generic quality metrics. Priya, can you push a short eval harness against live traffic?
Priya: Kicking off live-sample eval now. Results in ~60s.
Leo (support): On the customer bridge: "We're seeing better wording on some samples already." They asked for ETA on full fix.
Priya: Early telemetry: sampled rolled traffic pass rate jumped to 88% within 45s. No error spikes.
Noah: Promoting to 50%.
ops-bot: Routing update: helios-09 -> q8b_stable (50%).
Avery: Keep checks. If stable for 2 cycles, promote to 100%.
Priya: After second check, pass rate steady at 91%. Latency unchanged. No new errors.
Noah: Promoting to 100%.
ops-bot: Routing update: helios-09 -> q8b_stable (100%). job-4427 completed.
Avery: Confirming mitigation: Priya, can you sample production logs and confirm hallucination rate returned to baseline?
Priya: Sample confirms baseline behavior restored across 1k sampled requests. Correctness metrics within expected bounds.
Leo: Customer confirms on bridge that legal prompts look correct now. They're asking for a post-incident statement and whether the rollout will be paused.
Noah: I will block rollout-20260401-q8b_fast from other pools and add a canary guard for quant profiles that change attention kernels.
Priya: I'll prepare the RCA: kernel-level changes in `attn_opt` combined with a tokenization edge-case for our legal prompt style caused the regression. Will include diffs and recommended tests. ETA 24h.
Avery: On-call handoff: I'm handing to Leo (evening-sre) in 20m. Leo: you'll own monitoring and follow-through. Priya & Noah remain leads for technical root cause.
Leo: ack, taking over. Please DM me any outstanding runbooks and the current alert thresholds.
Avery: Incident state: mitigated - per-tenant profile revert applied, customer impact resolved. Downgrading severity to P2 for follow-up tasks. Documenting owners: Priya (ml root cause), Noah (runtime rollout block), Avery (postmortem writeup).
Leo: Noted. I'll keep alerts noisy and watch for reappears.
ops-bot: Incident 1835001111 marked mitigated by oncall at 1835001450. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1835001111/mitigated
Priya: Next steps: 1) run extended 6hr regression suite across corp prompt families (owner: Priya) 2) add per-tenant opt-out flag for future quant rollouts (owner: Noah) 3) customer postmortem & comms (owner: Leo/Avery).
Avery: Thanks team. Good quick action. We'll capture learnings for the deploy checklist and quant profile canary length. :thumbsup:
